# Kevin Zheng

> Personal academic website for Yuxiang (Kevin) Zheng, a PhD student at the University of Technology Sydney working on information diffusion, social data science, and robust machine learning.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://kyxzhe.github.io/): Research profile, chatbot entry point, and primary navigation.
- [About](https://kyxzhe.github.io/about): Biography, research focus, education timeline, teaching, and collaboration context.
- [Publications](https://kyxzhe.github.io/publications): Research papers, preprints, code, and related materials.
- [News](https://kyxzhe.github.io/news): Research updates, awards, teaching, and career milestones.
- [Contact](https://kyxzhe.github.io/contact): Email, collaboration topics, scheduling guidance, and official profiles.

## Research Topics

- Information diffusion
- Social data science
- Robust machine learning
- Trustworthy machine learning
- Misinformation modeling
- Temporal graph learning
- Multimodal representation learning
- Learning with noisy labels
